metadata.scenario: A client urgently needs a technician to fix a heating system breakdown during peak winter. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is William Chen. I'm calling because we have a heating system breakdown at home, and it's really freezing! Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that, William. That's definitely urgent. Can I get some details about the issue? Sure, the heat just stopped working, and it's getting really cold in here. I have a technician coming out soon. That’s good to hear you have someone coming. Just to clarify, are you feeling okay otherwise? Yes, but I have just had knee surgery and can't be moving around too much. The cold is making it uncomfortable. I understand, William. It's important to stay warm, especially given your recovery. Exactly! I was hoping maybe you could send someone to check on me, maybe even a nurse to help out? We can certainly arrange for a nurse to visit you. Would you like skilled nursing or personal care assistance? I think skilled nursing would be best, especially for my post-surgery care. Great choice. I’ll have a nurse come by for skilled nursing care, which includes medication management. That sounds good. How soon can you send someone? Let me check our schedule. We have a nurse available today at around 2 PM. Does that work for you? Yes, that would be perfect! Thank you! You're welcome! I'll confirm that appointment for you. Also, could you remind the nurse to bring extra blankets? It’s really cold! Absolutely, I’ll make a note of that for the nurse. Thanks. I really appreciate it, Margaret. Of course, and we'll also keep checking on your heating situation. That would be great! I’ll update you once the technician arrives. Perfect! Before we hang up, just to confirm, you’re scheduled for skilled nursing at 2 PM, right? Yes, that’s correct. Thank you, William. I’ll follow up on this, and I hope your heating gets fixed soon! Thank you, Margaret. Talk to you later! You're welcome! Goodbye!
